subject: BlueRiver Bio — orchestration & acceptance ramp for contract close
messages:
From: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@blueriverbio.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Glenn <sara.glenn@blueriverbio.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for evaluation & contracting

Laura — thanks again for yesterday's demo. Procurement and legal want a compact mutual action plan that ties evaluation acceptance criteria to contracting milestones. High level ask: can Redwood provide a one-page MAP we can circulate internally that sequences: final eval sign-off, MSA signature, DPA acknowledgement, order form + PO issuance? We have a budget window that requires legal sign-off by 9/24 and PO by 10/1.

Also a couple of gating items from our side: SOC 2 report (or equivalent evidence), and a sample Order Form showing billing cadence. Sara, our legal, copied for contract threading.

Can your team produce a MAP and proposed sequencing by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Mike
Mike Alvarez
Head of Procurement, BlueRiver Bio

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@blueriverbio.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Glenn <sara.glenn@blueriverbio.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueRiver — orchestration & acceptance ramp for contract close

Mike — appreciate the clarity. We can do that. Quick alignment from our side:

- Delivery: I'll drop a one-page MAP (spreadsheet + PDF) that maps acceptance criteria to owner and date. Draft will hit your inbox by EOD Monday (9/13).
- Sequencing principle: propose "Eval sign-off -> MSA redlines completed -> DPA issued & acknowledged -> Order Form executed -> PO received". We recommend staging the MSA signature before order form, with the DPA as an addendum signature if your legal prefers a separate doc.
- Owners: Karthik (Legal) will handle MSA redline response; Jonas (Account Exec) will own commercial/order form; Marissa (CS) will own acceptance criteria and pilot sign-off process.
- Evidence: SOC2 report and our compliance pack will be attached to the MAP as supporting artifacts.

If you're comfortable with the proposed order, I'll circulate the MAP and a short runbook that calls out timelines and blocker escalations. If BlueRiver needs an SLA tweak for pilot traffic levels, flag now so we can surface to product.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@blueriverbio.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Glenn <sara.glenn@blueriverbio.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueRiver — orchestration & acceptance ramp for contract close

Laura — that sequencing works for procurement. Two clarifications: 1) legal wants the MSA redline back in two business days after we return comments (we may have a short review window internally); 2) billing on the Order Form needs to support quarterly invoicing (we can request net-45).

SOC2 evidence is required before MSA countersignature; if Redwood can provide a redacted report or an auditor letter that will suffice for now. Sara, please confirm if anything else from legal.

We appreciate the quick MAP — Monday EOD is fine.

Best,
Mike

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@blueriverbio.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Glenn <sara.glenn@blueriverbio.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueRiver — orchestration & acceptance ramp for contract close

Mike / Sara — attaching a redline snapshot and a short note on sequencing. Key proposed steps from Legal (attached as PDF):

1) Receive BlueRiver comments on MSA -> Redwood will return a consolidated response within 48 hours. If we need additional time we will flag a 24-hour extension window.
2) DPA: we can include standard Redaction/Controller-Processor language; we propose signing the DPA concurrently with MSA to reduce churn, but are OK with DPA as a follow-up signature if BlueRiver prefers separate doc.
3) Order Form: commercial terms (billing cadence, effective date, usage banding) will be driven by the Order Form; Redwood requests that the Order Form include a contact for invoicing and a PO number field.

Attachments: MSA_redlines_karthik_20260912.pdf (redline), DPA_terms_summary.txt.

Note on SOC2: we will provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report via secure link; Redwood requires an NDA for full-scope evidentiary files — we can add that to the MAP if needed.

Karthik Iyer
Lead Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@blueriverbio.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Glenn <sara.glenn@blueriverbio.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: BlueRiver MAP & runbook (draft) — action items and target dates

Team — attached is the draft one-page MAP (BlueRiver_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short runbook PDF. Summary of agreed timelines (per the thread):

- 9/13 EOD: Redwood to deliver MAP + compliance pack (delivered on 9/13 16:40 PT). ATTACHMENT: BlueRiver_MAP_v1.xlsx
- 9/14: BlueRiver to share MSA comments (Sara).
- 9/16: Redwood to return consolidated MSA response (owner: Karthik).
- 9/20: Target for countersignature of MSA (subject to legal cycles).
- 9/24: Internal legal approval deadline (BlueRiver internal requirement).
- 10/01: Target PO issuance and billing start (owner: BlueRiver procurement).

Open blockers and notes:
- SOC2: Redwood delivered a redacted compliance pack and an auditor letter via secure link. Please confirm receipt; full SOC2 can be shared under a mutual NDA if needed.
- Billing cadence: Jonas will circulate a sample order form with a PO field and quarterly billing option for Sara to confirm.
- Escalation path: If any milestone slips by more than 48 hours, Jonas will escalate to commercial leadership and Laura will coordinate for SLA carve-outs for pilot traffic.

Next steps (short):
- Sara: send MSA comments into the shared doc by tomorrow EOB (9/14).
- Jonas: upload sample Order Form by 9/15 and confirm billing cadence options.
- Karthik: prepare consolidated redline response on 9/16.

Thanks all — Laura will maintain the live MAP in the HubSpot deal and circulate revised PDF after each milestone update.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: BlueRiver_MAP_v1.xlsx, MSA_redlines_karthik_20260912.pdf, DPA_terms_summary.txt
